title: The Soggy Screen Surprise
intro: Right before the big rooftop movie, someone sprayed the projector screen with water balloons and the film reel vanished.

suspects.name: Ruby
suspects.line: I was up on the ladder fixing the lights.

suspects.name: Omar
suspects.line: Bold of you to accuse me. I was in the snack line.

suspects.name: Maya
suspects.line: I was busy setting out the beanbags, honest!

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: Whoever did it has a serious sense of humour.

suspects.name: Theo
suspects.line: Water balloons? I only brought snacks, thanks.

clues.text: A popcorn bucket was found sitting untouched at the snack stand, and its owner has a clean alibi. The popcorn bucket carrier is not the culprit.
Muddy boot prints lead from the balloon bin toward the screen, matching the culprit's footwear. The culprit is the one wearing muddy boots.
A smear of drying mud on the ladder rail shows the culprit wore muddy boots. A yellow raincoat would have left no such trace, so the raincoat wearer is ruled out.
The film canister is still on its shelf, dry and unscratched, proving the canister carrier was never near the screen. The film canister is not the culprit.
